Лимит отправки: переменная окружения ``GAF_CHAT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN`` (см.

значение после разбора ограничивается диапазоном 30–120.

attachment_content_id.description: Optional unified_content id (sender's file) to attach; allowed with E2E ciphertext send.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional id of an existing message in this chat to reply to (quote).

e2e_session_key_for_recipient.description: Optional encrypted session key envelope for the recipient (handshake).

e2e_session_key_for_self.title: E2E Session Key For Self
e2e_session_key_for_self.description: Optional encrypted session key envelope for the sender (multi-device read-back).

SendMessageBody.title: SendMessageBody
SendMessageBody.description:
Body for POST `/gaf-chat/chats/{chat_id}/messages`.

Plaintext: set ``body``. E2E: you may omit ``body`` and send ``e2e_ciphertext`` (and related fields).
At least one of non-empty ``body`` or ``e2e_ciphertext`` is required — enforced in the router (HTTP 400).

note.title: Note
note.description: Optional short note appended under the app line in message body.

up_to_message_id.title: Up To Message Id
up_to_message_id.description: Mark read through this message id; omit or null for latest visible message.

MarkReadBody.title: MarkReadBody
MarkReadBody.description: Optional body for POST `/gaf-chat/chats/{chat_id}/read`. Omitted or `{}` marks read through latest.

body.title: Body
body.description: New plaintext; max 10000 characters after trim.

already_saved.title: Already Saved
already_saved.description: True if the file was already imported earlier.

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.description: Key algorithm label (e.g. curve or RSA variant).

has_key.title: Has Key
has_key.description: Whether a public key is stored.

chat_id.title: Chat Id
chat_id.description: Chat id this envelope belongs to.

encrypted_key_payload.title: Encrypted Key Payload
encrypted_key_payload.description: Opaque encrypted session key bytes (client encoding).

SessionKeyEnvelope.title: SessionKeyEnvelope
SessionKeyEnvelope.description: Response for GET `/gaf-chat/chats/{chat_id}/session-key` (opaque envelope for the current user).

bio.title: Bio
bio.description: Profile tagline / bio when visible to viewer (privacy + friendship).

ChatPartner.title: ChatPartner
ChatPartner.description: Other participant in a 1:1 chat (list payload).
